estimability_policy.confirmatory_rule: CI and two-sided bootstrap p-value are reported only when all 5,000 locked replicates are valid for that metric.
estimability_policy.error_capture_invalid_when: source_total_err==0 or target_total_err==0, or any other non-finite error-capture endpoint
estimability_policy.lift_invalid_when: source_total_pos==0 or target_total_pos==0, or any other non-finite lift endpoint

temperature_ranking_claim: Scalar temperature is strictly monotone for T>0; it is not credited with changing pure positive-risk top-k ordering.
